norm_perturbation.generator: dedicated torch.Generator (does not consume the global model-init RNG)
norm_perturbation.note: every LayerNorm affine (blocks.*.norm1/norm2, merger.norm, deepstack_merger_list.*.norm) is perturbed before the checkpoint is saved so the 16 norms are mutually distinct and the strict golden discriminates the tower's norm wiring (a norm1/norm2 swap, a weight/bias swap, the wrong norm on the merger versus a DeepStack merger, or a checkpoint-key typo would all change the captures)

provenance.key_prefix_note: the bare Qwen3VLVisionModel state dict carries plain keys (patch_embed.proj.*, pos_embed.weight, blocks.*, merger.*, deepstack_merger_list.*); the generator prepends 'model.visual.' to every key so the tiny checkpoint matches the real Qwen3-VL artifact key scheme (model.visual.*); all 99 tensors are stored as bfloat16

processor.note: transformers 4.57.6 has no Qwen3VLImageProcessor class; the slow PIL Qwen2VLImageProcessor is the pinned preprocessing path (WP1 probe precedent and jmlx-vision Qwen3Vl* port target). min_pixels/max_pixels are passed explicitly because the 4.57.6 __init__ overwrites any size dict with the 3136/1003520 defaults (findings §4.2). Images are passed as file path strings so the load_image (exif_transpose) path matches the Java processFile path; all areas lie inside [3136, 12845056] so smart_resize is a no-op.
